rules: AppSumo may be one source, but it may never be the only independent source.
Verify the product release date from a first-party launch post, changelog, documentation, or another strong dated source before scheduling a review.
Check Product Hunt and other dated launch directories as part of release-date research, but prefer a first-party dated record when one exists.
Never publish or backdate a review earlier than the verified product release date.
If no defensible public release date can be found, mark the candidate blocked and replace it. Never estimate a release date.
Use at least six sources, including two independent review platforms and one relevant community source.
Record the URL, access date, source type, sample count, and key themes for every source.
Treat vendor claims as claims until another source or hands-on testing confirms them.
Do not copy review wording. Summarize patterns and keep conflicting evidence.
Respect robots.txt, site terms, rate limits, authentication walls, and personal data.
Label anything we did not verify as unknown.
